newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-JOUBERT PULLS OUT OF SPRINGBOK TEAM.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-JOUBERT PULLS OUT OF SPRINGBOK TEAM.

text.p: South Africa's most capped player Andre Joubert has pulled out of the third and final test against the British Lions on Saturday because of injury.
The 33-year-old Natal full back injured his groin in practice on Thursday and was forced to withdraw from a Springbok back division already ravaged by injury.
He is the fourth back to be hit by injury following the withdrawal from the series of centres Edrich Lubbe and Japie Mulder as well as wing James Small after the first test.

Joubert, who has scored 10 tries in his 33 internationals, will be replaced by Border's Russell Bennett at Ellis Park on Saturday when the Springboks attempt to salvage some pride, having already lost the series 2-0.
It will be Bennett's first start for South Africa. He has twice come on as a replacement this season.

Joubert's absence increases the inexperience of a South African back division. Flyhalf Jannie de Beer will be making his debut while Pieter Rossouw on the left wing and centre Percival Montgomery will be winning only their second caps.

Reserve flyhalf Boeta Wessels pulled a thigh muscle during kicking practice on Thursday. His place on the bench is likely to go to Henry Honiball who was dropped from the squad after the defeat in the second test.
